fields.label: Prior to hire date, BlackRock will conduct a verification check to validate employees have legal authorization to undertake the role applied for, and to work in compliance with immigration laws in the country work location. Do you have legal authorization to work in the country work location (where the role is based)?*
fields.cur: Yes, I affirm I will be able to provide documentation to evidence my legal authorization to work for BlackRock in the country.

fields.label: Will you need to obtain, renew, extend or transfer a visa or work permit in order to commence work/maintain legal authorization to work at BlackRock in the country work location now or in the future? e.g. I can work now with my student visa, but will need support in obtaining a work visa next year*

Do you have a Personal Relationship* with a current BlackRock employee or contingent worker? *A Personal Relationship is defined as one that goes beyond the normal relationship between co-workers such that it may be viewed by a reasonable person as being susceptible to perceived impropriety, bias, favoritism and/or abuse of authority within a work environment. Examples of Personal Relationships include, but are not limited to, romantic or sexual relationships, substantial outside business relationships, and family relationships (as defined below). A family relationship includes, but is not limited to, spouse, domestic partner, child (including adopted), parent, sibling, grandparent, grandchild, aunt, uncle, niece or nephew, first cousin or corresponding in-law or “step” or “half” relation. For purposes of this policy, a family-like relationship (such as a godparent) is also considered a family relationship. Meeting a BLK employee at an event or during the recruiting process does not amount to a “Personal relationship”*
